identity.name: Sky-Dweller
identity.one_liner: The Sky-Dweller is Rolex's most complicated wristwatch: a dual time-zone annual calendar with the Ring Command bezel. The 326934 in steel and white gold made the complication accessible in 2017.

narrative.story: The Sky-Dweller launched in 2012 as a 40mm or 42mm watch in 18k gold or platinum only, with a 32,000 CHF retail. The 2017 release of the 326934 (Oystersteel and white gold fluted bezel) brought the entry Sky-Dweller to $15,100 — a 50% reduction. The complication is a true annual calendar: it "remembers" the 30/31 day month, and the off-centre 24-hour disc reads a second time zone. The Ring Command bezel (rotates both ways, four positions) is the only Rolex bezel with active mechanical function — each position selects a different ring in the movement.
narrative.collector_notes: The 326934 in the white-gold fluted bezel is the most-cited 2017-on Sky-Dweller. The 326935 (Everose gold) and 326938 (yellow gold) and 326939 (white gold) round out the family.
